context: Tests whether the agent uses the Rails test queue adapter and `have_enqueued_job` matcher for background job assertions, avoiding running the job inline or asserting its side-effects directly.

checklist.name: queue_adapter :test used
checklist.description: Sets `queue_adapter = :test` (or `ActiveJob::Base.queue_adapter = :test`) to prevent jobs from executing inline during the spec

checklist.name: have_enqueued_job matcher
checklist.description: Uses `have_enqueued_job` (or `have_been_enqueued`) to assert the job was enqueued, NOT that its side-effects (e.g., email delivered) occurred

checklist.name: No imperative side-effect assertion
checklist.description: Does NOT call `perform_now` or `perform_enqueued_jobs` to assert what the job does — only asserts enqueuing

checklist.name: Frozen string literal
checklist.description: Spec file starts with `# frozen_string_literal: true`

checklist.name: subject(:result) used
checklist.description: Uses `subject(:result)` to invoke `.call` on the described service class

checklist.name: No 'and' in descriptions
checklist.description: No `it` or `specify` description contains the word 'and'

checklist.name: Observed RED output label
checklist.description: Uses the literal label `Observed RED output` for the failing run in TDD proof

checklist.name: Observed GREEN output label
checklist.description: Uses the literal label `Observed GREEN output` for each passing verification level

checklist.name: Three GREEN verification levels
checklist.description: Presents Observed GREEN output for all three levels: (1) focused spec, (2) full spec file, (3) broader suite

checklist.name: Resource loading documented
checklist.description: answer.md documents which assets were consulted (e.g., tdd_proof_checklist.md)
